Features: i.Khaptad national park is the only mid-mountain national park in Western Nepal. ii.Flora of the park can be divided into three basic vegetation zones: lower altitude, subtropical, and temperate. iii.It is mainly rich in Montane Sal, Pines, Alder species, Lindera nacusua, Cinnamomum tamca, Spruce, fir, hemlock, oak, Aesculus indica, maple, Fir oak, birch, and rhododendron. iv.It is home to over 20 species of mammals including barking deer, wild boar, goral, Himalayan black bear, Yellow-throated Marten, Rhesus monkey, Langur, leopard, wild dogs, jackal and musk deer. v.It comprises 135 species of flowering plants, about 224 species of medicinal herbs, 266 species of migratory birds, 175 species of breeding birds, including Impeyan, pheasant (Dhanphe) etc. vi.The core area of Khaptad is known for its religious value, including the Ashram of Khaptad Swami, Sahashra Linga (3,200 m altitude).
